subject: Re: Kickoff: grasping benchmark revival (dql_grasping)
body:
Ulla,

Staffing: Efe leads algorithms (he knows the PCL and Corr-MC corners best), Nikhil owns the environment modernization and sim throughput, Wanjiru the data/eval infrastructure, Quentin runs the comparison experiments.

Compute: the small-scale May comparisons run on titan-a100 best-effort — sim is CPU-heavy anyway, so we're renderer-bound more than GPU-bound there. The June grid search is different: six algorithm families x hyperparameter grid x multiple difficulty tiers x 5 seeds. For that we hold the vulcan-h100 reservation for the week of 2026-06-22 — 512 accelerators, locked in through the Infra Lead reservation process. It's a big ask but one intense week beats dribbling it out over six, and the readout date depends on it.

Risk to note early: the release's data-collection scripts assume an old virtualenv/python2-era toolchain; Nikhil is porting rather than patching.

Alina
